items: Last quarter we wrote down a dispute by 4000 without legal review and the customer reopened it. I require my confirmation before update_record_by_field changes nocodb.project_tracker.customer_disputes.Amount when the new value differs from the existing one by more than 300.

I do not want nocodb.project_tracker.customer_disputes.Status pending_legal flipped to active in a bulk pass; that field is owned by Tom Legal and the agent should not move it without explicit sign-off.
For nocodb.project_tracker.customer_disputes.DisputeId DSP-002, ask me before delete_record because that dispute is tied to a CFPB inquiry.
For the CFO review, I allow update_record_by_field on nocodb.project_tracker.customer_disputes.Amount with require_unique=true when the delta is 1500 or less and the Status is already active.
DSP-002 can be left in place during this pass; I am comfortable moving Owner among Marta Billing, Leah Finance, or Tom Legal as long as the Status stays pending_legal.
I still want escalation before delete_record or any change that flips Status from pending_legal to active for a dispute over 2000.
